conscience.definition:
n. motivation deriving logically from ethical or moral principles that govern a person's thoughts and actions
n. conformity to one's own sense of right conduct
n. a feeling of shame when you do something immoral
conscience.translation:
n. 良心
[法] 良心, 道德感, 正义感

conscience money.translation: n. 心安钱, 赎罪金（为求得心安而付的钱）

conscience-stricken.translation: a. 内疚的, 受良心谴责的; 愧; 良心有愧

conscienced.translation: n. 良心, 道德心；道德意识；诚心, 诚意

conscienceless.translation: a. 没良心的, 不知廉耻的

consciences.definition:
n. motivation deriving logically from ethical or moral principles that govern a person's thoughts and actions
n. conformity to one's own sense of right conduct
n. a feeling of shame when you do something immoral
consciences.translation: n. 良心( conscience的复数形式 ); 内疚; 愧疚; 凭良心

conscientious.definition:
s. characterized by extreme care and great effort
a. guided by or in accordance with conscience or sense of right and wrong
conscientious.translation:
a. 有责任心的, 负责的, 本着良心的
[法] 凭良心做的, 有道德感的

conscientiously.translation: adv. 认真, 凭良心做, 尽心尽责, 谨慎, 诚心诚意

conscientiousness.definition:
n. the quality of being in accord with the dictates of conscience
n. the trait of being painstaking and careful

conscientization.translation: n. (拉美一些国家对贫苦文盲进行的)觉悟启蒙(运动)

conscientize.translation: 使意识到（重大社会或政治问题）；使觉悟

conscionable.translation: a. 凭良心的, 正直的

conscionableness.definition:
n. The quality of being conscionable;
   reasonableness.

conscious.definition:
s. intentionally conceived
a. knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts
s. (followed by `of') showing realization or recognition of something
conscious.translation:
a. 有意识的, 知觉的, 觉察的
[医] 有意识的, 清醒的

conscious error.translation: [计] 已知误差, 意识错误

consciousness.definition: n. an alert cognitive state in which you are aware of yourself and your situation
consciousness.translation:
n. 意识, 知觉, 自觉
[医] (有)意识, 清醒

consciousness of identity.translation: [医] 证同意识, 证同觉

consciousness of object.translation: [医] 对象意识, 客体意识, 物觉

consciousness of personality.translation: [医] 人格意识, 人格觉

consciousnesses.definition:
n. an alert cognitive state in which you are aware of yourself and your situation
n. having knowledge of
consciousnesses.translation: n. 知觉( consciousness的复数形式 ); 意识; 观念; 察觉

conscribe.definition: v. t. To enroll; to enlist.
conscribe.translation: vt. 征召入伍, 招募

conscript.translation:
a. 被征入伍的, 被征召的
n. 征兵
vt. 征召

conscript fathers.translation: [法] 参议员, 立法委员, 元老院议事官

conscripted.translation: v. 征召（某人入伍）( conscript的过去式和过去分词 )

conscripting.translation: v. 征召（某人入伍）( conscript的现在分词 )

conscription.translation:
n. 征兵, 募兵, 征用(制度)
[法] 征兵, 征用

conscriptions.definition:
plural of conscription
n. compulsory military service
conscriptions.translation:
(conscription 的复数) n. 征兵, 募兵, 征用(制度)
[法] 征兵, 征用

conscripts.definition:
n someone who is drafted into military service
v enroll into service compulsorily
conscripts.translation:
n. 应征入伍者( conscript的名词复数 )
v. 征召（某人入伍）( conscript的第三人称单数 )
